name: Jan Pokorný
bio:
Jan's journey into motorsport IT began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in Computer Science from the Czech Technical University in Prague, he initially worked for a corporate software firm. A lifelong love of racing, fueled by watching Formula 1 races on TV, led him to volunteer his IT skills at a local karting track. This experience ignited a passion for applying his expertise to the fast-paced world of motorsport. 

He believes in a proactive and adaptive approach to IT management, constantly seeking ways to optimize team performance through technological innovation. His dedication to ensuring seamless data flow and robust system security is paramount to Erebus Motorsport's competitive edge. Jan's meticulous nature and ability to remain calm under pressure distinguish him in the high-stakes environment of professional racing. He prides himself on anticipating potential IT issues before they impact the team's performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Jan is of average height with a slightly athletic build.

quirks: Prefers to communicate via email, even when colleagues are in the same room.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his glasses several times a day.
